programme.desc: It’s Halloween in Axle City, and Blaze, AJ, and all of their friends are excited to “Truck or Treat.” But when Crusher tries to steal all of their candy, his plan goes awry, and he sends their treats far, far away from Axle City.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze and AJ are playing with their friend Zeg when he accidentally gets blasted by a geyser into a far away mud pit. It’s up to Blaze and AJ to save him, and they must use engineering design inspired by their new dinosaur-truck-friends.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: It’s the day of the Piggy 500, and Starla is excited to race with her prize pig, Zippy, in a team race. But when her competitor Crusher and his rude pig, Slop, cheat and send Zippy far away, it’s up to Blaze, AJ, and Starla to find him.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: When Blaze smells smoke at Axle City’s garage, he calmly and courageously leads his friends outside to safety. Axle City’s fire chief is impressed with Blaze’s courage and thinks maybe he has what it takes to be a fire fighter, too.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze and Crusher discover a medieval kingdom holding a Royal Race! The two trucks become knights to compete in the race across the realm. But even though Sir Blaze is the speediest knight of all, Crusher's cheats won't make it easy to win.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: It’s Christmas Eve, and Blaze and AJ are helping Santa load his magic bag of presents to deliver all over the world. But Crusher accidently knocks over the bag and sends the presents flying.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Today Darington will attempt his biggest stunt yet: rocketing to the moon! But there's just one problem. His battery-powered rocket is out of energy. To get to the moon Blaze must help Darington recharge his battery.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze, Stripes, and AJ are racing through the jungle when Stripes discovers a lost little fire beetle named Sparky. Blaze and his friends set off across the jungle to help Sparky get back home to the top of a red hot volcano.

programme.title: South Park: Sauvez Wilzy-X
programme.desc: Les enfants mettent tout en œuvre pour sauver Wilzy-X, une orque du bassin, et pour tenter de réaliser son rêve d'aller sur la lune. Ils ne réalisent pas qu'ils sont victimes d'un canular.

programme.title: South Park: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: Le père de Stan est alcoolique. Le petit garçon tente d'aider son père, d'autant que celui-ci est très mal conseillé par les Alcooliques Anonymes.

programme.title: South Park: Le Retour de Chef
programme.desc: Chef est de retour à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Danger Snobfog
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park achètent des voitures hybrides. Toutefois, alors que les habitants commencent à se sentir mieux parce qu'ils sauvent la planète, une masse noire orageuse recouvre la ville.

programme.title: South Park: Un million de petites fibres
programme.desc: Towelie écrit un livre qui est sélectionné par le club de lecture d'Oprah. Il devient un best-seller et se destine aux gens cherchant à dépasser leurs dépendances.

programme.title: South Park: Homoursporc
programme.desc: Les enfants essaient d'aider l'ancien vice-président Al Gore à se faire entendre par la population mais ils se retrouvent coincés dans une grotte. Alors qu'ils essaient d'en sortir, Cartman découvre un trésor.

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: La mère d'Éric n'a aucun contrôle sur son fils. Elle fait alors appel à plusieurs Nounou mais chacune échoue à leur mission. Un dresseur de chien prend alors la relève pour dompter Éric.

programme.title: South Park: Make Love, Not Warcraft
programme.desc: Les garçons jouent à World of Warcraft pendant tout le week-end lorsqu'un méchant joueur les tue sans aucun remord.

programme.title: South Park: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir
programme.desc: Cartman croit savoir qui est à l'origine des attaques du 11 septembre.
programme.sub-title: Le Mystère du caca dans l'urinoir

programme.title: South Park: La Maitresse de Ike
programme.desc: C'est au tour de Cartman d'être le surveillant des couloirs, il profite de l'autorité qui lui est confié pour faire régner l'ordre sévèrement. Pendant ce temps, Ike tombe amoureux de sa maîtresse et ils ont une relation ensemble.

programme.title: South Park: L'Enfer sur Terre
programme.desc: Satan organise une énorme fête pour petite gamine pourrie gâtée pendant que les enfants de South Park tentent d'invoquer le rappeur Biggie Small en prononçant trois fois son nom devant un miroir.

programme.title: South Park: Vas-y Dieu, Vas-y Dieu (1/2)
programme.desc: Éric ne supporte plus d'attendre la sortie de la Nintendo Wii et ne veut pas endurer trois semaines de patience supplémentaire. Il décide alors de se congeler pour se réveiller le jour de la sortie de la Wii.

programme.title: South Park: Vas-y Dieu, Vas-y Dieu (2/2)
programme.desc: Toujours 500 ans dans le futur, Cartman est mêlé à la guerre mais ils est plus préoccupé à trouver un moyen de jouer à la Wii. Cela étant impossible dans le futur, il cherche une façon de retourner à son époque.

programme.title: South Park: La Coupe Stanley
programme.desc: Stan entraîne l'équipe poussins de hockey et essaie d'en faire des gagnants.

programme.title: South Park: Avec nos excuses à Jesse Jackson
programme.desc: Randy Marsh dit le mot « nègre » à la télévision nationale et devient la risée du pays ; Cartman se moque d'un nain et se bat contre lui.
programme.sub-title: Avec nos excuses à Jesse Jackson

programme.title: South Park: La Photo
programme.desc: Cartman veut faire croire que Butters est gay, mais lorsque le père de ce dernier s'en aperçoit, il envoie Butters dans un camp de rééducation.

programme.title: South Park: Les Poux
programme.desc: Une infection de poux atteint l'école primaire de South Park. Alors que Madame Garrison refuse de donner des noms, Cartman trouve un moyen de savoir qui a des poux et ainsi de se moquer des enfants atteints.

programme.title: South Park: Chattomique
programme.desc: Un nouvel élève arrive a South Park : un jeune arabe. Cartman pense alors qu'un attentat se prépare. Grâce à Kyle, branché sur Internet, ils remontent la piste d'un attentat imminent sur Hillary Clinton en visite à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Le Fantastique Mystère de Pâques
programme.desc: Stan se demande pourquoi on doit peindre des œufs le jour de Pâques. Il ne s'attendait pas à découvrir un secret aussi énorme.

programme.title: South Park: G-Win!
programme.desc: Madame Garrison se fait plaquer pour la dernière fois. Elle compte bien passer toute sa colère sur sa classe de CM1.

programme.title: South Park: La Nuit des clochards-vivants
programme.desc: La ville doit faire face à une recrudescence des SDF. Les enfants vont essayer de régler ce problème épineux.

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Cartman prétend avoir le syndrome Gilles de la Tourette pour pouvoir dire des choses affreuses en direct à la télévision.

programme.title: South Park: Gros Caca
programme.desc: Randy est constipé. Il prend alors des laxatifs pour aller déféquer. Après quelques instants de terribles douleurs sur le trône, Randy s'apprête à tirer la chasse mais il remarque que son caca est démesurément grand.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 1
programme.desc: Eric assure avoir aperçu un leprechaun dans la forêt, mais Kyle ne le croit pas. Ils font un pari ensemble : si Cartman prouve l'existence du leprechaun, Kyle devra lui sucer les boules sinon il devra donner 10$ à Kyle.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 2
programme.desc: Les pires créatures ont été libérées par les terroristes et dévastent Imaginationland, où Butters est toujours piégé. Le gouvernement réquisitionne Stan et Kyle afin de trouver un moyen d'entrer à Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland Episode 3
programme.desc: Suite à l'accident du portail, Stan est entré dans Imaginationland où Butters est considéré par les créatures imaginaires comme un élu capable de sauver Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Zéro
programme.desc: Stan et Kyle sont accros au jeu Guitar Hero. Mais Stan est meilleur que Kyle, et leur amitié semble s'en dégrader.

programme.title: South Park: La Liste
programme.desc: Les filles ont une liste des garçons les plus beaux de la classe. Clyde est premier, mais à sa grande déception Kyle est dernier.

programme.title: South Park: Amygdales
programme.desc: Cartman se retrouve à devoir lutter pour sa vie lorsqu'une banale opération des amygdales tourne mal.

programme.title: South Park: Le Nouveau Look de Britney
programme.desc: Alors que les garçons aident Britney Spears à atteindre le pôle Nord, ils découvrent le secret qui se cache derrière sa popularité.

programme.title: South Park: Planète Gros Nibards
programme.desc: Dans cet hommage de South Park au film de 1981 « Métal Hurlant », les garçons découvrent que ce qui défonce réellement, c'est le pipi de chat.

programme.title: South Park: Canada en grève
programme.desc: Lassé d'être ridiculisé, le Canada se met en grève pour avoir plus d'argent et du respect. Cependant, personne ne prend cette grève au sérieux, excepté les enfants.

programme.title: South Park: Ciel, une quéquette !
programme.desc: Madame Garrison tente de trouver un moyen de redevenir l'homme qu'elle aurait toujours dû être. Cartman doit alors la remplacer et s'occuper de la classe.

programme.title: South Park: Y'a plus d'Internet
programme.desc: Les habitants de South Park se réveillent et découvrent qu'ils n'ont plus Internet.

programme.title: South Park: Un épisode chez les cow-boys
programme.desc: Monsieur Garrison emmène ses élèves en voyage scolaire dans un village de pionniers reconstitué. Alors que Cartman passe la journée avec Butters dans son sillage, des malfaiteurs arrivent dans le parc.

programme.title: South Park: Le Problème Chinois
programme.desc: Cartman développe une véritable paranoïa envers les chinois à cause du cauchemar qui hante ses nuits depuis peu : la cérémonie d'ouverture des JO de Pékin.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While sailing through haunted waters, the Straw Hats encounter a ghost ship that's home to a walking, talking skeleton!
programme.sub-title: THE MYSTERIOUS SKELETON FLOATING THROUGH THE FOG! VENTURE INTO THE DEVIL'S SEA!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats attempt to unravel the mystery of their new comrade, but the skeleton's sad story is interrupted by a ghastly landing at the haunted island of Thriller Bark!
programme.sub-title: THE JOY OF SEEING PEOPLE! THE GENTLEMAN SKELETON'S TRUE IDENTITY!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After getting stranded at Thriller Bark, Chopper, Nami, and Usopp are chased by a three headed beast. Back on the boat, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats are terrorized by an unseen enemy!
programme.sub-title: ONE UNNATURAL PHENOMENON AFTER THE NEXT! DISEMBARKING ON THRILLER BARK!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Chopper, Nami, and Usopp get scared out of their minds when they encounter a graveyard full of zombies! Meanwhile, the rest of the crew gets trapped in super creepy sea web!
programme.sub-title: THE MAN CALLED A GENIUS! HOGBACK MAKES HIS APPEARANCE!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: An invisible man turns Nami's bath time into a harrowing experience, and Usopp battles a hall full of haunted paintings with a handful of burning candles!
programme.sub-title: NAMI'S IN A MAJOR PINCH! THE ZOMBIE MANSION AND THE INVISIBLE MAN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Usopp, Nami, and Chopper seek to unravel the secrets of the haunted mansion, Luffy and the gang do battle with an army of the undead!
programme.sub-title: THE ZOMBIE'S SECRET! HOGBACK'S NIGHTMARISH LABORATORY

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy sets his sights on the shadowing-stealing monster known as Gecko Moria, and the zombie army prepares for a night attack led by their perverted, invisible leader!
programme.sub-title: HIS NAME IS MORIA! THE GREAT SHADOW-SEIZING PIRATE'S TRAP

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp, Chopper, and Nami get trapped in a coffin after being slashed by a zombie samurai. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats make short work of some haunted paintings!
programme.sub-title: FEAST OF THE ZOMBIE SONG! THE NIGHT HUNT'S BELL IS THE SOUND OF DARKNESS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After escaping from their coffin prison, Usopp, Chopper, and Nami do battle with a garden full of adorably dead zombie animals!
programme.sub-title: A BUNCH OF ANIMALS? PERONA'S WONDER GARDEN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: An undead warthog sets her sights on Nami, Zorro and Sanji vanish without a trace, Franky and Robin battle an unbeatable army, and Luffy gets captured!
programme.sub-title: THE VANISHING STRAW HAT CREW! A MYSTERIOUS SWORDSMAN APPEARS!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A penguin zombie starts acting an awful lot like Sanji, Nami continues running for her life, and Robin and Franky buy some time by blowing up a bridge!
programme.sub-title: CHIVALRY REMAINS! THE TRAITOROUS ZOMBIE PROTECTS NAMI

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami gives love advice to a zombie, Luffy finds himself face-to-face with Gecko Moria, and Robin gets caught in spooky spider web. Things look bleak for the Straw Hats until their skeleton friend lends a hand!
programme.sub-title: APPEARING FROM THE SKY! THAT MAN IS THE HUMMING SWORDSMAN!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook strikes the final blow in his battle with the spider monkey, Gecko Moria's devious plan is revealed, and Luffy's escape attempt leads to the loss of something he can't live without!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY'S EMERGENCY SITUATION! THE ULTIMATE SHADOW'S DESTINATION!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook tells Franky and Robin the secret to slaying zombies, and Gecko Moria reveals the terrifying monster that will be the recipient of Luffy's shadow!
programme.sub-title: THE WARRIOR KNOWN AS THE "DEVIL"!! THE MOMENT OF OARS' REVIVAL

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's shadow is forced into the body of a monster, Usopp and Chopper get incinerated, and Nami is kidnapped by a zombie who wants to make her his wife!
programme.sub-title: AWAKENING AFTER 500 YEARS!! OARS OPENS HIS EYES!!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Gecko Moria's minions struggle with the burden of feeding a giant zombie brought to life by Luffy's shadow. Meanwhile, Brook flashes back to a battle that almost cost him his beloved afro!
programme.sub-title: A BELIEF WORTH BEGGING TO LIVE FOR!! BROOK DEFENDS HIS AFRO

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The freshly-revived trio of Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji discover that their shadows are missing, and Franky relates Brook's story about a promise he made to a very special whale!
programme.sub-title: A MAN'S PROMISE NEVER DIES!! TO THE FRIEND WAITING UNDER THE DISTANT SKY

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and the Straw Hats flash back to the heartbreaking story of Laboon the abandoned whale, and Brook's battle with the zombie samurai reveals the reason behind his intense afro love!
programme.sub-title: I SWEAR TO GO SEE HIM!! BROOK AND THE CAPE OF PROMISE

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy sets out to regain his shadow and convince Brook to join the crew. Meanwhile, Sanji races to stop Nami's zombie wedding before it's too late!
programme.sub-title: FOOD, NAMI AND SHADOWS!! LUFFY'S ENRAGED COUNTERATTACK

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp's naturally negative personality makes him the only Straw Hat who stands a chance against Perona's depressing army of ghosts, and Chopper prepares to do battle against his hero, Dr. Hogback!
programme.sub-title: USOPP'S THE STRONGEST? LEAVE ANYTHING NEGATIVE TO HIM

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: When Brook is overmatched by the zombie samurai, Zoro steps in to help the skeleton get his shadow back. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares for a battle with Gecko Moria, and Sanji interrupts an undead wedding!
programme.sub-title: THE GENERAL ZOMBIES ARE DOWN IN A FLASH!! OARS FEELS LIKE AN ADVENTURE!!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Despite his furious attempts, Luffy struggles to land a blow against Gecko Moria, but Sanji fares much better in his passionate attempt to defeat Nami's beastly abductor!
programme.sub-title: BLAZING KNIGHT SANJI!! KICK DOWN THE FAKE WEDDING

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji takes a beating when his opponent suddenly turns invisible, Luffy finally manages to land a blow in his battle with Gecko Moria, and Usopp uses fire to ward off a zombie bear!
programme.sub-title: A CLEAR-CLEAR HISTORY? SANJI'S STOLEN DREAM

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: After getting the stuffing beat out of him by a zombie teddy bear, Usopp summons his sharp-shooting alter ego to help him discover the secret to defeating Perona!
programme.sub-title: SAVE ME, HERO!! MY ENEMY IS THE IMMORTAL PRINCESS

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Usopp reaches deep into his devious bag of tricks to even the odds in his battle with Perona. Meanwhile, Luffy can't lay a finger on Gecko Moria, and a zombie is less than gentlemanly in his battle with Robin!
programme.sub-title: PERONA IS TERRIFIED!! USOPP AND UNTRUTHFUL SHARE THE SAME "U"

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Franky and Brook watch in awe, Zorro and the zombie samurai wage a sword-slinging battle the likes of which the world has never seen before!
programme.sub-title: SLASHES DANCING ON THE ROOFTOP!! SHOWDOWN: ZORO VS. RYUMA

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Chopper can no longer contain his fury over Dr. Hogback's evil treatment of his zombie slaves. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares to face the zombie who's wearing his shadow!
programme.sub-title: CHOPPER IS FURIOUS!! HOGBACK'S EVIL MEDICAL PRACTICES

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Moria's mansion is reduced to ruins as the zombie with Luffy's shadow stalks the Straw Hats! As the walls come tumbling down, Chopper puts the hurt on Hogback, and Nami vanishes right before Sanji's eyes!
programme.sub-title: OARS ROARS! COME OUT, STRAW HAT CREW

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: One by one, the Straw Hats attack Oars, but the monstrous zombie appears too powerful to be defeated. Luffy's got his sights set on Moria, but he'd better hurry if he wants to save his crew!
programme.sub-title: LUFFY IS THE ENEMY! THE ULTIMATE ZOMBIE VS. THE STRAW HAT CREW

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami wakes up just in time to find out she's about to marry a zombie, but the special occasion is interrupted by very jealous warthog!
programme.sub-title: YOU'RE GOING DOWN, ABSALOM!! NAMI'S LIGHTNING ATTACK OF FRIENDSHIP!!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami attempts to track down some missing treasure, Brook searches the kitchen for a mystery ingredient, and a heroic team effort topples Oars!
programme.sub-title: KNOCK HIM DOWN!! SPECIAL ATTACK: STRAW HAT DOCKING?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami has a horrifying run in with Bartholomew Kuma, Perona becomes the latest lady to vanish, and Chopper, Franky, and Usopp team up to strike a blow against Oars!
programme.sub-title: THE SILENT ASSAULT!! THE MYSTERIOUS VISTOR, "TYRANT" KUMA

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Kuma has an upsetting message for Moria, Luffy loses track of his intended target, and Zoro attempts to harness the power of a new sword during his battle with Oars!
programme.sub-title: OARS + MORIA / THE MOST HEINOUS COMBINATION OF BRAINS AND BRAWN

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Brook arrives with the salt needed to stop Oars, but the monster shows off some special new abilities. Deep in the forest, Luffy makes some new friends who help him power up!
programme.sub-title: THE SECRET PLAN TO TURN THE TABLES / NIGHTMARE LUFFY MAKES HIS APPEARANCE

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots' Special Day: Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots most favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: To The South Pole: Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin! It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Pingüino all the way back home to the South Pole.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora Saves The Game: Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What Happens Next?: What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale, and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Rescue, Rescue, Rescue: Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boot's Cuddly Dinosaur: It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Super Silly Fiesta: Bawk! It's fiesta time! Dora and Boots are invited to the Big Red Chicken's Super Silly Fiesta! There will be silly snacks, silly games, silly hats and even silly dancing.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: The Fix-It Machine: Uh oh! Boots has a hole - un hoyo - in his boot! But Dora knows what to do. They can go to the Super Duper Fix-It Machine to fix it right up!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Baseball Boots: Boots loves baseball. He loves to run and catch and throw, but so far he's never gotten a hit. Boots is determined to get his first hit. Dora and Boots have a big baseball game today.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Happy Best Friends Day! Today's a special day for best friends to play together. Boots and Dora decide to meet for a picnic to celebrate. Boots is bringing chocolate; Dora is bringing yummy strawberries.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: A is for armadillo, but where are the rest of the animals in the ABC book? They're missing! Dora and Boots jump into the giant alphabet book to help the little armadillo solve the mystery.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: What do you want to be when you grow up? On today's adventure, Dora and Boots get to try all sorts of jobs - from a pilot to a chef to an archeologist. But what will Dora decide to be when she grows up?

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Excited, Dora puts the Star Pocket on Backpack and Dora and Boots set off on their very first star catching adventure. Their educational journey will take them all the way to the Cloud Castle, as they try to rescue an adorable baby star.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora tells the story of how she first met Boots. On their very first adventure, Dora and Boots have to bring instruments back to the Fiesta Trio so they can play for the cranky Queen Bee.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Oh, no! Dora left her music homework in Boots' room. It's a song in English and Spanish, and she needs Boots to bring it to her school so she can sing it to the class.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora's baby brother and sister just love bananas, but they also love stories! So Dora tells them a Super Babies story! The Super Babies have to get their bananas back from that Super Villain Swiper the Fox.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer

programme.title: Dora the Explorer

programme.title: Dora the Explorer

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora and Boots are playing catch when they discover a lost Baby Fox. And he wants his mommy! Just then, Swiper shows up to swipe Boots' superball.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Boots and Tico are really excited because it's their first day of school ever -- and in their new school, they'll learn in English and Spanish!

programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 1 The Fugitoid: Our four heroes find themselves beamed halfway across the universe to the planet D'Hoonnib and right into the middle of a police action! There, they befriend the Fugitoid, a.k.a. Professor Honeycutt.

programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 2 The Trouble with Triceratons

programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 3 The Big House

programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 4 The Arena: Welcome to the Tri-sports Arena filled to capacity with cheering Triceraton crowds thirsty to watch grueling combat. Our four heroes have been sentenced to become gladiators in ruthless competition.
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 4 The Arena

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Turtles in Space - Part 5 Triceraton Wars: With Professor Honeycutt (the Fugitoid) safely in tow and the Prime Leader as a hostage, the turtles are faced with their biggest challenge yet!
programme.sub-title: Turtles in Space - Part 5 Triceraton Wars

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Secret Origins - Part 1: Back from their adventures in space, the Turtles find themselves in the headquarters of the same aliens who teleported them across the universe! The discovery of an old friend and new allies leads to a trip back through time.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Secret Origins - Part 2: The turtles and Splinter have taken a little trip down the Utroms' memory lane via a high-tech virtual reality device experiencing first hand the Utroms' crash landing on Earth and their life in feudal Japan.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Secret Origins - Part 3: The Turtles and Splinter escape the Utroms' high-tech virtual reality device, only to find the Shredder and all his forces waiting for them. All shell breaks loose in yet another final showdown between our heroes and the Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Ultimate Ninja: There's a bad dude in town, and he's looking to pick a fight with Leonardo. This Ultimate Ninja has come halfway across the inter-dimensional universe to fight the Shredder, defeat him and gain glory.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.sub-title: Modern Love - The Return of Nano

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: What a Croc!: The Turtles discover that they're not alone in the sewer. The green ooze which mutated them years ago also claimed another victim… Leather Head!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return to the Underground: The Turtles return to the ancient underground city they discovered in "Notes From the Underground" -- only to find the city abandoned, its crystal moon power source missing, and its human population reverted to monsters.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City at War - Part 1: With the Shredder gone, underworld factions clash for power in a gang war that threatens to tear the city apart!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City at War - Part 2: The Turtles find themselves in the middle of an escalating gang war between the remains of the Foot, the Purple Dragons and the mob (with their new ally Baxter Stockman!) Can the Turtles survive the deadly onslaught?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: City at War - Part 3: The turtles have their hands full fighting the mob, the Purple Dragons and what's left of the Foot. Now, they've joined forces with Karai, who used to be the Shredder's right hand "man." Can they trust her?

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Junklantis: Now that they've got a ShellSub, the Hudson River becomes the Turtle's underwater wonderland… NOT! The junk in the riverbed is even more dangerous than the city above when the Turtles run into their old nemesis the GarbageMan!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Golden Puck: Casey Jones loves the new sport of Super Slam Hockey. It's the pure evolution of a great game into a perfect game. But, when the legendary Golden Puck is stolen from the Super Slam Hockey rink in Central Park, Casey's beyond indignant.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Rogue in the House - Part 1: The Shredder is back … rested up … recuperated and repaired, and he has a new plan for global domination. The only thing he wants to do first is exterminate the turtles. Call it a trial run of his new ideas.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Rogue in the House - Part 2: Embracing a plan at gaining power through a number of FootMechs under his control, the Shredder has sent a robotic Splinter to seek and destroy our turtles.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: April's Artifact: The Turtles stumble across an antique puzzle cube that belonged to April's father, who mysteriously disappeared a few years ago. Messing with the cube, the Turtles and April are transported to another dimension…

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Return of the Justice Force: Mikey's quest for a rare comic book leads the Turtles and Casey back to Northampton, where they stumble on a mystery madman's plot to kidnap all the remaining members of a retired super hero team known as the Justice Force.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Big Brawl - Part 1: As he does every three years, Splinter mysteriously goes off leaving his four boys at home. Where he's going, he won't say. Unbeknownst to Splinter, the four boys are curious and follow.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Big Brawl - Part 2: Finding themselves in an inter-dimensional tournament, our four teenage mutant ninja turtles discover a past about Splinter they never knew...

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Big Brawl - Part 3: As the BattleNexus Tournament continues, Leonardo has been poisoned and lies unconscious fighting for his life. Splinter is wrongly imprisoned for an attempt on the Daimyo's life.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Big Brawl - Part 4: It's down and dirty time. Splinter is imprisoned. Leo is dying of poison. Don and Usagi are fighting for their lives and the life of the Daimyo against a horde of assassins.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The Christmas Aliens: Christmas is supposed to be a time of giving, not taking! But when a dangerous gang of theives hijack a truck full of holiday toys on it's way to an orphanage, it's time for Michelanglo to start passing out some season's beatings!

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Space Invaders - Part 1: The Triceratons have invaded looking for the Fugitoid. Unfortunately, no one on earth knows what the heck the big horn heads are talking about.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Space Invaders - Part 3: Searching for the captive Donatello, Leonardo, Raphael and Michelangelo sneak their way into Republic Central, the hub of the Triceraton Homeworld.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Worlds Collide - Part 2: Just when our four turtles thought they had fooled the Triceratons and disguised the Fugitoid, they find themselves captives of the Military.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Touch and Go: Welcome to the New World...same as the Old World. While the Turtles attempt to assess the damage around their lair, they find that adjusting to their post alien invasion lives might be harder than they thought.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Hunted: For a two ton reptile, Leatherhead actually makes the ideal houseguest; neat, tidy, always pays his rent on time … except for the fact that his temper is really out of control.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: H.A.T.E.: Donatello, Michelangelo and Raphael come across a band of crazed, heavily armed, alien-hating Survivalists, bent upon delivering and detonating a thermo nuclear device in New York City.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Nobody's Fool: When Michelangelo and Leonardo are out getting a little night air, they cross paths with a caped crusader who ends up saving their lives. The Turtles soon learn that he's really a cop who is out to get the one man who ruined his career.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Caractère de tortue

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Nouvel ami, vieil ennemi
programme.desc: Pour prouver que les tortues ninja peuvent se lier d'amitié avec des humains, Michelangelo se fait un ami sur un réseau social. Mais cet ami est-il digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Je crois qu'il s'appelle Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Lorsque les tortues quittent le repaire contre l'avis de Splinter, elles font la rencontre de Baxter Stockman, un inventeur dérangé vêtu d'une armure de combat.
programme.sub-title: Je crois qu'il s'appelle Baxter Stockman

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Malin comme un singe
programme.desc: En enquêtant sur la disparition d'un scientifique, Donatello et April croisent la route d'un singe au comportement bizarre et découvrent un complot.

programme.desc: Léo pourrait regretter d'avoir fait preuve de clémence, quand Xever prend en otage le propriétaire d'un restaurant de nouilles chinoises.

programme.desc: Michelangelo devient ami avec un alligator mutant déséquilibré qui est en possession d'un étrange outil de technologie appartenant aux Krangs. Mais est-il digne de confiance ?

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une fille mystérieuse
programme.desc: Las d'entendre les critiques de Raph, Léo laisse son frère diriger l'équipe. Pendant ce temps, Léo rencontre une belle et dangereuse kunoïchi.

programme.desc: Les tortues doivent faire face à nouvel ennemi, le Roi des Rats, qui menace de prendre le contrôle de la ville, mais aussi de l'esprit de Splinter.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le plan des Krangs
programme.desc: Quand les devoirs d'école d'April attirent l'attention des Krangs, les tortues prennent le lycée d'assaut.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le Pulvériseur
programme.desc: Les tortues ont un problème avec le Pulvériseur, un adolescent qui se prend pour un héros et qui veut combattre le crime à leurs côtés.

programme.desc: Alors qu'elles tentent de déjouer le plan d'invasion de la Terre par les Krangs, les tortues sont pourchassées par un cafard géant et indestructible.

programme.desc: Quand Shredder projette de créer une armée de mutants, les tortues demandent l'aide de leur plus grand fan.

programme.desc: Leonardo, Raphael et Donatello deviennent les esclaves d'une guêpe mutante. Leur sort dépend de leur frère Michelangelo.

programme.desc: April reçoit un message codé. Pendant que ses frères dorment, Donatello tente de le déchiffrer. C'est Kirby O'Neil, le père d'April, qui appelle à l'aide...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutation accidentelle

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Mutagène-man se déchaîne

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: L'acné mutante de Mikey

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Une cible nommée April O'Neil

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Slash la tortue

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: La conspiration des Krangs

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones

programme.sub-title: Le bon, la brute et Casey Jones

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tête d'acier Version 2.0

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Tremblement de ver ! - Partie 1

programme.desc: Tandis que les tortues combattent Karaï et les Foot, Leonardo tente de révéler à Karaï la vraie identité de son père, mais en vain. La terre tremble, et elle en profite pour s'éclipser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja: Les mutants du labyrinthe
programme.desc: Les quatre frères se passionnent pour un jeu de rôles, et décident de se déguiser pour faire une partie « grandeur nature » dans les égoûts.

programme.desc: Buster is in charge of the community garden, but it proves to be too much for just one person. Arthur can't find his glasses and has to get new ones, but the attention he is getting from these new glasses has gone straight to his head!
programme.sub-title: Buster's Garden of Grief/Through the Looking Glasses

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Bailey is missing! Muffy discovers a series of clues and is left wondering, who exactly IS Bailey? Then, everyone loves getting trophies, right? It turns out that Fern could not care less about them.
programme.sub-title: The Butler Did...What?/The Trouble with Trophies

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: There's a new kid in town: Ladonna Compson, the Louisiana native with the gift of gab. Ladonna charms Arthur and friends with her amazing "true" stories. But are her stories really fact…or fiction?

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Muffy posts a goofy video of Francine on the Muffington Post, Francine worries she will become the laughing stock of the entire school. And it's the 1st Annual Lakewood Derby and Muffy's revved up!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: When Emily gets the starring role in the preschool play, D.W. is beside herself with jealousy. She should be Little Red Riding Hood, not Tree #2! Then, D.W. and Emily are upset when they get stuck with the blocks at playtime.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Everyone loves HUGO--the new interactive whiteboard that claims to be 100% accurate. If only Mr. Ratburn knew how to use it. Mei Lin can say "hello" AND play the piano?!? Kate can't even wave!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Tibble Twins are having their first sleepover! Will the Tibbles lock James in the dark basement? Then, a cupcake's been stolen! The primary suspect: Tommy Tibble. D.W. gathers a jury and demands that justice be served.
programme.sub-title: Night of the Tibble/Read and Flumberghast

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Tough Customers realize it's time to quit bullying and set out to find a new hobby--but can Molly ever truly change her ways? And Brain starts a chess club at school to improve his game and beat Los Dedos, the local chess master.
programme.sub-title: The Last Tough Customer/Brain's Chess Mess

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's Grebelings season and George can't wait to play! After all, no one knows more about baseball than George. Then, wBrain gets teamed with Buster and Binky in the annual Arithmattack competition.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Lakewood Elementary has just instituted IRP; a program where kids can earn points (and prizes!) for reading. Then, Buster and Brain never agree on movies. Buster rates every film a 10+, while Brain doesn't seem to like anything.
programme.sub-title: Buster's Book Battle/On the Buster Scale

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Fern has writer's block! Fortunately, Ladonna's full of stories, and Fern decides to "borrow" the tales and simply change the names. Then, when Sue Ellen decides to stop eating meat, Muffy and Francine compete to be the best vegetarian.
programme.sub-title: Fern and the Case of the Stolen Story/Sue Ellen Vegges Out

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur thinks his jokes about Sue Ellen's new sweater are in good fun but Sue Ellen's feelings are hurt. Has Arthur become a bully? Everyone is reminiscing about their "best days." Except Arthurs. Is it possible he doesn't have one?
programme.sub-title: So Funny I Forgot to Laugh/The Best Day Ever

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: It's the Elwood City dog show and Killer is facing off against Sebastian Winkleplotz, the snooty, championship-winning poodle. Arthur agrees to watch Amigo while Alberto's off at camp, but Pal gets worried.

programme.desc: D.W. and Bud embark on an epic wilderness adventure--the backyard has never been so exciting! Apple picking, bake sales, craft classes…there's so much to do in Elwood City in the fall! And Ladonna's determined to do it all.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: While repairs are being made to the noodle shop, Mr. Ping turns the training hall into a restaurant!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Oogway returns to the Jade Palace, throwing Po and Shifu's relationship into turmoil.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Shifu's con-man father comes back into town, Po finds himself in the middle.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po is excited when he discovers a kung fu prodigy, but starts to worry when people seem to prefer the new kid to their beloved Dragon Warrior.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po befriends a band of dancers, unaware they're actually a band of traveling thieves.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When the Furious 5 are all out of town and the Jade Palace is attacked, Po only has his dad and two old people to help him.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: A rash of thefts in the Valley of Peace has the villagers in uproar and things only get worse when the culprit appears to be... Monkey?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po's Kung Fu hero, Kwan the Unkillable, comes to the Valley of Peace and appears to be a feeble old man. Po agrees to stage a fight to help him get back on top. But Kwan may not be as weak as he looks.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Tigress is forced to babysit a small child who has been separated from his parents.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and Mantis visit the equivalent of an ancient Chinese Comic-Con, where Po's fanboy enthusiasm gets out of hand.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po's visit to a famous war hero goes awry when he finds out the retired general is off his rocker.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po tries to help Crane get his "mojo" back after Crane is humiliated at a charity event.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Shifu throws out his back, Po has to sit in as master of the Jade Palace.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When kung fu is outlawed, Po turns to donning a mask to fight crime.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po's worst childhood fears come true when he comes face to face with hopping ghosts! (Special Halloween Episode)

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When two Croc Bandits have a spat, it's up to Po and Mr. Ping to set things right.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: In an attempt to get out of training, Po buys some enchanted shoes that will heighten his kung fu abilities. Unfortunately for Po, the magical shoes are evil and will soon put him and all those around him in great danger.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po is embarrassed when his dad takes him on a wild goose chase, but it turns out his dad is not so crazy afterall.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Master Mugan from the Garnet Palace decides she needs a new Kung Fu Master, Tigress volunteers. Will the Furious Five be minus one or will Po convince Tigress to return to the Jade Palace?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po's friend Peng returns to the Valley of Peace, everyone is excited...except for Po. What no one else knows is that Peng is actually evil Tai Lung's nephew. Now Po has to admit to powerful Peng that he is the one who skadooshed his uncle.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: As the annual Winter Festival approaches, Po doesn't have enough money to buy his dad the present he deserves, so he takes a job as a bounty hunter to capture a dangerous escaped convict for the reward. But Po's plan doesn't go as smooth as he hoped.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po takes on the challenge of training a lovable but klutzy member of the Emperor's family. However, will Po's training be enough to protect them both from the evil designs of a traitor in their midst?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: After dealing Taotie yet another humiliating defeat, Po is horrified to learn that the villainous warthog has had a full on nervous breakdown. Po is determined to heal his spirit and Taotie is eager to change his evil ways...or is he?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po's fake love letter prank on Monkey backfires, the duo's relationship is put to the test in a story of jealousy, betrayal and, yes, even kidnapping.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po is sad when he learns that everyone has been invited to a dinner party except for him, due to his poor table manners. Will Shifu be able to teach Po proper etiquette AND foil the attack of evil Temutai and his army?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Shifu's ex-girlfriend, Mei Ling, visits the Jade Palace, Po decides to try and get them back together, despite the fact Mei Ling is now Shifu's most hated enemy.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and Tigress must track down and stop a messenger from delivering a scroll that could thrust China into all-out war!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and the Furious Five meet their greatest challenge yet: a supernatural creature who is invincible to the powers of kung fu.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Crane's mom visits the Valley of Peace. Crane reveals to Po that his mom hates Kung Fu so he promised her that he would never have anything to do with it. Crane asks Po and the others to help him keep his secret from his mom.
programme.sub-title: Mama Told Me not to Kung Fu

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Self-conscious about his size, Mantis ingests a growth potion that makes him huge. Mantis is initially thrilled with the results, but soon his large size puts the entire village and his friends in grave danger.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: With Po and the Furious Five at each other's throats, Shifu takes them all on a disastrous road trip.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po is possessed by the ghost of evil Master Ding, it's up to Tigress to save him before Ding can unleash his powers and enslave the Valley of Peace.

programme.desc: The coaches face off to save their teams from elimination, and the competitors test their artistry with mermaid Elimination Tattoos.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates a popular new website that dishes the dirt on non-celebrities. On creator Nik Richie's controversial site, TheDirty.com, people anonymously submit photos & negative comments about anyone in their community, tabloid style.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This 2004 YouTube viral video sent shock waves, racked up millions of views, and stirred online outrage. Texas Judge William Adams is lashing his then 16-year-old daughter with a belt, despite her pleas to stop. Do you think Adam's actions are justified?
programme.sub-title: Discipline Video: A Daughter's New Accusations Against The Judge

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Don't miss Dr. Phil receiving his star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame! Plus, time is of the essence for mom Cindy. Daughter Cheyenne, 24, is a college student, Cindy's caretaker & sole financial supporter. Boyfriend, Blake, calls Cheyenne 'Cinderella'.
programme.sub-title: Dr. Phil Hollywood Walk Of Fame/My Mooching Mom Has 5 Months To Get A Life

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you imagine getting an inheritance, you might assume all your financial problems would be solved. But can the money be more trouble than it's worth?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The tense family drama continues. Dr. Phil sent Private Investigator Harold Copus thousands of miles through three countries including the jungles of Belize to find two sisters, Allene and Mollie, who were abducted by their father one year ago. Part 3

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you constantly have to compromise to get along with your mate? Do you feel like you have to give up a vital part of yourself to be in a relationship? Dr. Phil talks to controlling guests, and the loved ones who feel trapped by them.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do couples give up too easily on marriage? More newlyweds, married only a few months, are pulling off their wedding bands and calling it quits. Dr. Phil's guests haven't even been married a year, and are already wondering if they made the right decision.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you and your beloved say "I do," it's "for better or worse." But what happens when all you feel is the "worse" part and wind up trapped in a bad marriage?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can a man introduce another woman into his marriage and form a healthy, "triangular" relationship, in which he is shared by his wife and his mistress? Part 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What makes a good wife? Is it cooking, cleaning, raising the kids and having great sex? Dr. Phil says too few couples understand what it means to be a "Mrs." He delves into the role of the wife in 2005.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They threaten, scream, intimidate and even bite. They are not tantrum-throwing tots ... they are bullying dads!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meet three women ready to divorce controlling, chauvinistic husbands. At Dr. Phil's Man Camp, an intensive week-long stay in The Dr. Phil House, can these couples repair the damage from their toxic attitudes, explosive fights and abusive behaviors? Part 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They track your every move and monitor your conversations. This may sound like the latest GPS locator, but they are actually meddling moms!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when a household is in total meltdown and filled with constant battles? Meet a mother who is afraid of her 17-year-old son and the stepfather who says he's caught in the middle. But is the boy the only one to blame for the chaos in the house?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A bride-to-be takes on her future mother-in-law in an ugly feud that has torn a family apart. Can Dr. Phil cut through the drama and broker some peace for this family?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Michelle thought she had a perfect marriage until Wade admitted to keeping a horrible secret from his wife. Little did she know this one revelation would be the tip of the iceberg. Dr. Phil continues the startling story of Wade and Michelle. Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are you ignoring warning signs in your relationship? Is there something concerning you that you haven't addressed? Dr. Phil warns his viewers: Don't think your problems will go away once you walk down the aisle, face the issues now before it's too late!

programme.desc: Can married people be friends with someone of the opposite sex without sex getting in the way? At what point does a friendly relationship become an affair of the heart or emotional infidelity? Meet Randy, who says his wife, Amanda, has crossed that line.

programme.title: Sierra Sue
programme.desc: State Inspector Gene Autry helps ranchers rid their ranches of poisonous devil weed threatening cattle. The ranchers want to burn the area, but Gene thinks chemical spraying via airplane is in order.

programme.title: Riders Of The Whistling Pines
programme.desc: Gene Autry believes he has accidentally shot a man, but learns that the guilt lies with men trying to stop a destructive moth infestation. Will modern chemicals be used to save the day, against Gene?

programme.title: The Way West
programme.desc: Icons Kirk Douglas, Robert Mitchum and Richard Widmark star in this sumptuous, epic tale of the brave men and women in the U.S. who left the comfort and safety of life in the East for the promise of free land a better life in the untamed West.

programme.title: The Shooting

programme.title: In Old Monterey
programme.desc: Gene Autry tries to persuade farmers to sell their land for a military proving ground. Gene discovers that mine owners are stirring up the ranchers to con the government to pay more for their land.

programme.title: Back In The Saddle
programme.desc: When pollution poisons hundreds of cattle, Gene Autry, faces trouble from all sides. Originally released in 1941, this film features Gene's signature song and his lovable sidekick, Smiley Burnette.

programme.title: Red River Valley
programme.desc: Cowhand Gene Autry and his partner, Frog Millhouse, help Arizona cattlemen who are trying to build a dam that will bring water to their parched lands. Unscrupulous businessmen attempt to hinder these plans for their own profit.

programme.title: The Missouri Breaks
programme.desc: Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson ignite the screen in this rousing story of a wealthy Montana rancher who hires a professional killer to track down a gang of horse thieves.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: Can Dare Rudd prove he is responsible enough to win the heart of Judy and also outwit the crooked saloon owner?

programme.title: Arizona Days
programme.desc: Tex and sidekick Grass join McGill's traveling show. When Price has McGill's wagons burned, Tex becomes the county tax collector to earn money. This leads to trouble as one of those owing money is Price who says he will not pay.

programme.title: Heart of the Golden West
programme.desc: Lambert owns the trucking line that ships cattle to market. When he raises his rates Roy decides to ship the cattle on the River Boat. When Lambert and his men are unable to stop the boat, they rustle the cattle.
